Legacy Capital Partners Inc. trimmed its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.0% during the 3rd quarter, Holdings Channel reports. The firm owned 66,100 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 690 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for approximately 5.4% of Legacy Capital Partners Inc.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its biggest position. Legacy Capital Partners Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $10,187,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds have also modified their holdings of the business. Catalyst Capital Advisors LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 57.8% during the 3rd quarter. Catalyst Capital Advisors LLC now owns 110,337 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $17,006,000 after purchasing an additional 40,437 shares during the last quarter. BW Gestao de Investimentos Ltda. boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 26.9% in the 3rd quarter. BW Gestao de Investimentos Ltda. now owns 37,719 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,813,000 after buying an additional 8,000 shares during the last quarter. Stephens Inc. AR boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 2.5% in the 3rd quarter. Stephens Inc. AR now owns 245,550 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $37,844,000 after buying an additional 5,903 shares during the last quarter. Waldron LP boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 8.6% in the 3rd quarter. Waldron LP now owns 19,926 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,070,000 after buying an additional 1,585 shares during the last quarter. In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through this link . Company insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock. 
A number of research firms have recently issued reports on AAPL. Vetr upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $184.49 price target on the stock in a research note on Monday. ValuEngine upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research note on Thursday, March 1st. BidaskClub upgraded Apple from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating in a research note on Saturday, February 17th. Raymond James Financial restated a “market perform” rating on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, February 16th. Finally, Bank of America restated an “outperform” rating and issued a $220.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday, February 8th. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-four have assigned a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $201.58. 
Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $176.82 on Tuesday. The company has a market capitalization of $894,091.88, a PE ratio of 18.17, a P/E/G ratio of 1.33 and a beta of 1.19. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $137.05 and a 12-month high of $180.62. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm’s revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the business posted $3.36 earnings per share. analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.43 EPS for the current year. 
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Investors of record on Monday, February 12th were given a $0.63 dividend. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.43%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 25.90%.
